basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Server Administrator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) has notified 1 vacancy for the Server Administrator post on a contract basis, with applications to be submitted offline on or before 23 October 2026. The engagement is initially for 1 year, and candidates must be willing to relocate to and work from the IIT Indore campus. Eligible applicants holding a B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline can apply for this full-time, on-site position. The notified pay is up to Rs. 80,000 per month, with the exact amount to be decided based on qualifi

age_limit.details: Maximum age: 40 years . Age, Education, Experience and other eligibility criteria can be relaxed if the candidate is found to be exceptionally good.

qualification.details: B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline with 5 years of relevant experience in server administration and its related areas; OR M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline with 3 years of relevant experience in server administration and its related areas; OR MCA with 5 years of relevant experience in server administration and its related areas. | Hands-on experience in server administration, including server setup, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers in a production environment. Experience with user management, security settings, and system hardening. Proficiency in managing virtualized environments (VMware, XCP-ng/XOA, KVM, Hyper-V). Experience in taking backups and restorations and planning for disaster recovery. Good understanding of firewall, network protocols, and enterprise security best practices. | RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator) or equivalent certification in Linux system administration. MCSE (Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert) or relevant Windows Server certification. Experience with the administration of HPC Servers, Familiarity with Data Centre Activities. | Maximum age: 40 years. Age, Education, Experience and other eligibility criteria can be relaxed if the candidate is found to be exceptionally good.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and technical skill test to assess their expertise in system administration.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Server Administrator post at IIT Indore permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for 1 year, and it is extendable based on performance through an outsourcing agency.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age or qualification relaxations?
faq.answer: Age, education, experience, and other eligibility criteria can be relaxed if the candidate is found to be exceptionally good.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview and a technical skill test to assess their expertise in system administration.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates apply for remote or work-from-home opportunities?
faq.answer: No. Candidates seeking remote or work-from-home opportunities are requested not to apply, as this is a full-time, on-site position requiring work from the IIT Indore campus.
